title: oncidium × praevisum
intro: Oncidium × praevisum, commonly known as the "dwarf oncidium," is a hybrid orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oncidium × praevisum include vasodilation, which can help to improve blood flow and reduce blood pressure, as well as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
